parameters.description: Only transactions sending at least this many tez, such as 100. Leave empty for any amount.
parameters.name: min_amount

parameters.description: Only those from this moment on.
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.description: Only those up to this moment.
parameters.name: until_time

parameters.description: Newest or oldest first. Defaults to newest.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The currency to give prices and values in. Defaults to US dollars.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Which Tezos network to read. Defaults to Mainnet.
parameters.name: network

account.description: The account the list was narrowed to, if any.

currency.description: The currency the price and value are in: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, cny, krw, btc or eth.

more_available.description: True when the list stopped at the number asked for, so more may exist.

network.description: The network read: mainnet or shadownet.

amount_tez.description: The tez sent, which is 0 for many contract calls.

baker_fee_tez.description: The fee paid to the baker, in tez.

direction.description: With an account: received, sent or self (it sent to itself). Empty otherwise.

entrypoint.description: The contract entrypoint called, such as transfer. Empty for a plain transfer of tez.

errors.description: Why it failed, in Tezos's words, when it did.

fee_tez.description: Every fee paid for it, in tez: the baker's and the storage.

hash.description: The operation hash, which 'Get operation' and every explorer take. Several transactions can share one.

id.description: TzKT's id for it. Ids only grow, so a later transaction has a larger one.

initiator_address.description: For a transaction a contract made: the account whose call started it.

is_internal.description: True when a contract made it while running, rather than a wallet sending it.

parameter.description: What the call passed to the entrypoint, as JSON.

price.description: The price of one tez in that currency at the time. Empty on a test network.

sender_alias.description: The name TzKT knows the sender by, such as an exchange or a dapp, when it has one.

status.description: applied (it went through), failed, backtracked (undone by a later failure in its group) or skipped.

storage_fee_tez.description: Tez burned for the storage it used.

target_alias.description: The name TzKT knows the target by, such as an exchange or a dapp, when it has one.

tzkt_url.description: Its page on TzKT, the Tezos explorer.

value.description: The tez amount times that price: what it was worth then. Empty on a test network.

description: Read the Tezos blockchain through TzKT, the explorer by Baking Bad: account balances and balance history, transactions and operations, blocks and cycles, tokens and NFTs with their holders and transfers, smart contract entrypoints and storage, bakers, network statistics, the XTZ price and Tezos Domains names, on Mainnet or Shadownet. Start a workflow when an account has a new transaction or token transfer. No account or API key required. Data provided by TzKT API (https://tzkt.io).

tzkt_new_token_transfer_trigger.description: Runs when a Tezos address sends or receives a token or NFT (mints and burns included), once it is final, with the amount in whole tokens, the token's name and the operation hash. Optionally only received or sent, or only one contract's tokens or one token.

parameters.description: The address to watch, tz1... or KT1..., such as a wallet or a contract.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Only what it receives, or only what it sends. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Only tokens of this contract (KT1...), such as KT1XnTn74bUtxHfDtBmm2bGZAQfhPbvKWR8o for Tether USDt. Leave blank for every token.
parameters.name: contract

parameters.description: With a contract: only this token of it, such as 0. Leave blank for every token of the contract.
parameters.name: token_id

parameters.description: Which network to watch. Leave blank for Mainnet.
parameters.name: network

tzkt_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs when a Tezos address sends or receives a transaction (a transfer of tez or a contract call), once it is final, with its amount in tez, fees and entrypoint. Optionally only received or sent, from an amount up, one entrypoint, or failed ones.

parameters.description: The address to watch, tz1... or KT1..., such as a wallet or a contract.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Only what it receives, or only what it sends. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Only transactions of at least this many tez, such as 10. Leave blank for any amount, contract calls sending none included.
parameters.name: min_amount

parameters.description: Only calls to this contract entrypoint, such as transfer or mint. Leave blank for every transaction.
parameters.name: entrypoint

parameters.description: Only transactions that went through, only failed ones, or both. Leave blank for those that went through.
parameters.name: outcome

parameters.description: Which network to watch. Leave blank for Mainnet.
parameters.name: network
